detail: Measured on 3e53d7bc5 production, small preset, 1,000 POSTs (13 automatic checkpoints), clean runs (no heap hook), peak read from a 50 ms /proc sampler: trigger 64 MiB peak anon 138.0 / 134.9 MB, peak RSS 237.4 / 234.2; trigger overridden to 8 MiB for the publication (encapsulating fnn-gc-nursery-octets) peak anon 92.6 / 95.6, peak RSS 191.6 / 194.4; 2 MiB peak anon 86.8, RSS 185.7. Steady end-of-run RSS unchanged within noise. Latency not established: hbox was at load 10-27 (76-175 ms/POST for one configuration); pair A 174.5 vs 164.5 ms. Not train-ready: the 64 is a book constant, so the heap-figure keystones (books/heap-open-nursery.lisp, heap-store-figure) re-prove and the reservation formula changes. Evidence hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem/s2 s4 s6 pA0 pApub8388608 (samples.csv, usage.txt).
notes: 2026-10-07 N-MEM7 latency (3 interleaved pairs, set 3e53d7bc, hbox light I/O load, loadavg 4.6-7.7): 64->8 MiB cuts VmHWM 226.1->189.6 MB (-36.5) and leaves batch count unchanged (13/13/13 vs 14/13/13), but mean publication duration 9.2->11.4 s (+13..32%), GC time 2.1->4.0 s per 1000 POSTs, POST p50 +3..8 ms (~+10%), p95 +3..15 ms, p99/max not worse, wall +4..8 s per 1000 POSTs. Method: runtime encapsulate of fnn-gc-nursery-octets, no image change. Table and runs: build/coordinator/MEMORY-20261006.md 'MEM-007 latency'; build/coordinator/mem7-latency/. Held for ember: the trade is his call; state unchanged.
title: publication collection trigger 64 MiB (profile-limits :gc-nursery-mib) puts a 40 MB spike on RSS and anon during checkpoints; 8 MiB removes it
